suggestions: I'm grateful for a PR that got approved with just one "nice work" comment instead of twenty change requests.
I'm thankful for the roti canai guy who remembers my order before I even finish parking the bike.
I'm grateful for catching a memory leak in testing instead of getting paged for it at 3am.
I'm thankful for the breeze that hits right when you step out of an overly air-conned office.
I'm grateful for the twenty quiet minutes after Isyak when the whole house finally goes silent.
I'm thankful for my mum texting "dah makan?" in the middle of a stressful sprint, snapping me out of it.
I'm grateful for a flaky test that finally stopped being flaky after I actually read the error message properly.
I'm thankful for a warung that still has nasi lemak left when I show up embarrassingly late for lunch.
I'm grateful for the rezeki of colleagues who cover for me without making it a whole thing.
I'm thankful for a Jumaat that ends early enough to actually enjoy the rest of the day.
I'm grateful for the first sip of coffee that actually tastes right, not burnt, not watery, just right.
I'm thankful for my little cousin asking me to fix her laptop, like I'm some kind of tech genius.
I'm grateful for a sprint retro where someone finally said what everyone was quietly thinking.
I'm thankful for the sound of rain on a zinc roof while I'm still half asleep on a Saturday.
I'm grateful for a senior engineer taking the time to explain instead of just fixing it himself and moving on.
